name: RC-B10-0404/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the killing of opposition member Mutotwe Kafwaya after Zambia's August 2026 elections and the arrests and intimidation of opposition members and supporters. It asks Zambia to investigate unlawful force, release or fairly try detainees, and protect free speech and the media. It also asks the European Union to raise these concerns with Zambia and support local rights groups and journalists.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only asks Zambia and the European Union to act.
- **Who it affects:** Zambia's government, opposition members, detainees, journalists and civil society.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the European Union, the African Union, the United Nations and Zambia.
